uutiset.t: Prediction Market Rule from CFTC Under White House Review
uutiset.s: A final rule to bring more clarity to prediction market contracts is under review by the White House, as US regulators look to provide more guardrails for the multibillion-dollar industry.

uutiset.t: Braskem, Creditors Reach Deal on Out-of-Court Debt Revamp
uutiset.s: Braskem SA and its creditors have reached an agreement on the main terms of an out-of-court restructuring deal, a key step in the Brazilian petrochemical giant’s efforts to rework its debt after months of tense negotiations.

uutiset.t: UBS, Barclays Stuck With €1.2 Billion Debt as Irca Deal Unravels
uutiset.s: UBS Group AG and Barclays Plc are among banks that have been stuck with €1.2 billion ($1.3 billion) of committed financing following CVC Capital Partners’ withdrawal from the acquisition of Irca SpA.

uutiset.t: Credit Heads ‘Swivel’ as Huang Return Ignites Tech Debt Rally
uutiset.s: Corporate-debt markets rallied globally on Monday, with US fear gauges improving the most in months and technology firms’ bonds rebounding, after Nvidia Corp.’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive officer.

uutiset.t: Canadian Stocks Recover as Huang’s Return Fuels Metals, Tech
uutiset.s: Canadian stocks staged a sharp rebound on Monday, fueled by surging precious metals and technology stocks, after Nvidia Corp. reinstated Jensen Huang as its chief executive officer.

uutiset.t: Woolworths Investors Reject Pay Report in Shareholder Rebuke
uutiset.s: Shareholders in Woolworths Holdings Ltd. overwhelmingly rejected the South African retailer’s remuneration report, delivering a sharp rebuke over executive pay as new rules give investors greater say over compensation.

uutiset.t: AI-Linked Stocks Take Off as Nvidia Brings Back ‘Black Jacket’
uutiset.s: Shares of companies tied to artificial intelligence surged Monday after Nvidia Corp. reinstated Jensen Huang as president and chief executive officer, effective immediately.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Shares Fluctuate as AI Sector Rallies on Nvidia CEO Return
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC shares turned negative in early Monday trading, with the artificial intelligence lab lagging behind the rest of the sector’s rebound following the reinstatement of Nvidia Corp.’s Jensen Huang.

uutiset.t: Stellantis Quits Auto Racing as CEO Ramps Up Cost Cuts
uutiset.s: Stellantis NV is withdrawing from auto racing, as the car manufacturer pushes ahead with cost cuts and a turnaround plan that’s struggling to win over investors.

uutiset.t: US Business Activity Expands at Slowest Pace in Four Months
uutiset.s: US business activity expanded at the slowest pace in four months as high prices, shipping delays and capacity constraints weighed on factory owners and service providers.

uutiset.t: Forint Jumps After Hungary Softens Interest-Rate Guidance
uutiset.s: The Hungarian forint jumped after the central bank softened its monetary policy guidance, citing a more limited room to cut interest rates after a market selloff.

uutiset.t: Poland’s IPO Rush Builds as Defense Firms Join Listings Wave
uutiset.s: Poland’s IPO revival is gathering momentum, as companies tied to the country’s record military buildup bolster the listings pipeline.

uutiset.t: US, UK Firms Cut FX Hedges to Lowest Since 2024 Amid Losses
uutiset.s: Companies in the US and UK scaled back their currency hedges in the third quarter by the most in more than two years, even as they saw losses from unprotected currency volatility rise, an industry survey shows.

uutiset.t: Tech Companies Are Getting More Creative to Raise Billions
uutiset.s: The biggest tech companies are increasingly finding that to borrow the hundreds of billions of dollars they want to fund artificial intelligence investments, they need to get creative.
